app_tagline: Challenge your friend — race the balance to zero!
pass_subtitle: Don't look! Wait until the player has the device.
rules_paragraph_1: You compete with your friends to see who reaches zero with their balance first. Each player starts with their own balance (you choose the number in Settings, like 700), and everyone only plays with their own balance — your balance has nothing to do with your opponent's.
rules_paragraph_2: On your turn, you say the name of a football player who scored goals for the club or in the competition you chose. The number of goals they scored is deducted from your balance. For example, if your balance is 700 and you say a player scored 400 goals, your balance becomes 300.
rules_paragraph_3: You must reach exactly zero to win. If you name a player who scored more goals than the balance you have left (for example, you have 10 left and you say a player scored 11), the attempt is cancelled and your turn is lost without your balance being affected.
rules_paragraph_4: Every player name can only be said once in the whole round — as soon as someone says it, it goes onto the "burned" list and no one can say it again, even on their own turn.
rules_paragraph_5: The first player to bring their balance exactly to zero wins immediately.
result_bust_body: Balance couldn't cover that — turn lost, no deduction.
result_burned_body: This player was already used in this game.
result_timeup_body: The clock ran out before you answered — turn lost.
result_not_associated_body: This player has no record for the selected club in this league.
